spans.s: लुभ् vt. or vi. 4P (pp. लुब्ध; pres. लुभ्यति) 1. To desire eagerly, to long for anything, (with a dat. or loc.); 2. to allure; 3. to go astray, to be perplexed.

लुभ् Caus. (लोभयति-ते) 1. to excite desire, यथामुखीनः सीतायाः पुप्लुवे बहु लोभयन् Bt.v.48; 2. to attract, to seduce, to allure, लोभ्यमाननयनः श्लथांशुकैर्मेखलागुणपदैर्नितंबिभिः R.xix.26; 3. to excite lust; 4. to disturb, to derange.With प्र-, to allure.With वि-, 1. to attract, to allure, अंगनास्तमधिकं व्यलोभयन्नर्पितप्रकृतकांतिभिर्मुखैः R.xix.10, K.S.iv.20; 2. to divert, to amuse.
